title: Row span as a generated subspace
statement: Let $m,n$ be natural numbers and let $H$ be an $m\times n$ matrix over $\mathbb{F}_2$. The image of the linear map given by left multiplication by $H$ is the subspace of $\mathbb{F}_2^n$ spanned by the rows of $H$.
